listing.name: Bust A Groove — BustAGrooveRecompiled-Releases (brankomatija)
listing.summary: The project claims 60 FPS, rendering and controller support. Portcove has not confirmed a complete playthrough or the release contents. The optional settings launcher belongs to this same implementation. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own PS1 USA SCUS94263 CUE/BIN; SHA1 4b206a8263a3f08965885f662c03cee76e745ec1 (hash scope must be checked).

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the project’s Windows x64 ZIP, place your own SCUS94263 CUE/BIN in disc and use BustAGroove_Recompiled.exe. Portcove has not confirmed the archive contents, its source correspondence or package trust.
